# PlusMinusBang (PMB)

> A plain-text notation for structuring reasoning. A line-initial symbol marks
> what kind of thought a line is (`+` pro, `-` con, `!` critical, `?` unknown,
> `*` hard condition, `~` uncertain); indentation marks what it responds to. Learnable
> in under a minute. Public domain (CC0). Works anywhere you can write text.

## Spec

- [pmb.md](https://plusminusbang.com/pmb.md): The complete normative spec in one
  file, under 1k tokens. Read this one file to become fluent.

## Prompts

- [reader.txt](https://plusminusbang.com/prompts/reader.txt): Understand PMB when you encounter it
- [writer.txt](https://plusminusbang.com/prompts/writer.txt): Emit your own reasoning as PMB
- [converter.txt](https://plusminusbang.com/prompts/converter.txt): Restructure a prose dump into PMB

## Optional

- [SPEC.md](https://plusminusbang.com/SPEC.md): Long-form spec with rationale and examples
- [GUIDE.md](https://plusminusbang.com/GUIDE.md): Usage guidance, patterns, common pitfalls
- [WHY.md](https://plusminusbang.com/WHY.md): Motivation, use cases, who it is for
- [examples/](https://plusminusbang.com/examples/): Worked examples across situations
- [DECISIONS.md](https://plusminusbang.com/DECISIONS.md): Why each symbol means what it does; open questions
- [skill/SKILL.md](https://plusminusbang.com/skill/SKILL.md): Drop-in agent skill (Claude and compatible)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://plusminusbang.com/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to propose changes
